title: Every conscious state is caused by neurobiological processes

statements.text: All conscious states, without exception, are caused by neurobiological processes in the brain, and there is nothing to the causal power of consciousness that cannot be explained by the causal power of its neuronal base. Searle says the evidence for this is overwhelming.

sources.quote: All conscious states, without exception, are caused by neurobiological processes in the brain.
There is nothing to the causal power of consciousness that cannot be explained by the causal power of the neuronal base.
